text: Mosaic UI is the internal operations console used by Platform, Ops, and Support teams to view and manage client account records and case notes. Access is role-based and must be requested through ServiceNow.

Mosaic UI is the internal operations console used by Platform, Ops, and Support teams to view and manage client account records and case notes. Access is role-based and must be requested through ServiceNow.

title: Mosaic UI Access Request Procedure
text:
| Role | Grants | Typical requester |

| `MOSAIC_UI_VIEWER` | Read-only access to account views, transaction history, and case notes | Support agents, new engineers during onboarding |

| `MOSAIC_UI_ADMIN` | Everything in `MOSAIC_UI_VIEWER` , plus the ability to edit account flags and trigger reconciliation jobs | Platform engineers, on-call responders |

| | | |

Role names are case-sensitive and must match the Sentinel IAM Role Catalog exactly. If a request references a role name that isn't in the catalog, Sentinel will reject the provisioning step even if a human approver signs off.

title: Mosaic UI Access Request Procedure
text:
- Open the ServiceNow Access Catalog and search for "Mosaic UI Access" .

- Select the role you need ( `MOSAIC_UI_VIEWER` or `MOSAIC_UI_ADMIN` ) and provide a one-line business justification.

- Your request routes automatically to your manager for the first approval.

- After manager approval, the request routes to the Mosaic Platform Team Lead for the second and final approval.

- Once approved, Sentinel provisions the role automatically — no manual ticket to Platform is required.
SLA:
2 business days end-to-end under normal conditions. If you haven't heard anything after 2 business days, follow up in
`#mosaic-platform-support`
on Slack rather than re-submitting the request.

title: Mosaic UI Access Request Procedure
text: Access is reviewed quarterly by the Mosaic Platform Team as part of the standard access recertification cycle. If your role changes and you no longer need Mosaic UI access, ask your manager to submit a revocation request through the same ServiceNow catalog item — select "Revoke" instead of "Request" from the dropdown.

title: Mosaic UI Access Guide
text: Mosaic UI is the console used to look up client account details and transaction history. If you need access, here's how to get it.
embedding_text:
Page: Mosaic UI Access Guide
Section: Mosaic UI Access Guide

Mosaic UI is the console used to look up client account details and transaction history. If you need access, here's how to get it.

title: Mosaic UI Access Guide
text:
Most people just need read access, which is the
`mosaic-ui-read-only`
role. To request it:

- Send an email to helpdesk@meridian.example with the subject line "Mosaic UI Access Request."

- Include your manager's name and a short reason for the request (e.g. "new hire, need to look up account records").

- The helpdesk forwards your request to the IT Manager , who approves standard read-only requests.

- Once approved, IT will set up your access and email you a confirmation.
Turnaround is usually about a week, depending on how backed up the helpdesk queue is. If you haven't heard back after 10 business days, reply to your original email and CC your manager.
